Several papers describe automated clustering for discovering topics or communities. ClusterFusion combines embedding-guided partitioning with LLM topic summarization and assignment [1], while TriTopic uses a graph combining semantic embeddings, TF-IDF, and metadata with consensus clustering [2]. Other topic-discovery approaches include multilingual embedding and density-based clustering [3], adaptive dimensionality reduction with embedding clustering [5], and hierarchical density modeling that reveals topics at multiple scales [8].

For community clustering specifically, an unsupervised graph-based system detects communities of arguments using relationships such as topic similarity and shared keywords [7].
